evidence.symbol_note: Symbol resolves as the PLAIN file-static mangling ?compute_apres@@YAXXZ, NOT an anonymous-namespace-hashed ?compute_apres@?A0x...@@YAXXZ. The wave-15 lane assumed an anon-namespace hash; this build emits the plain ?...@@YAXZ name (MSVC mangles file-static functions without the anon-namespace bracket). query_functions and run_objdiff both resolve ?compute_apres@@YAXXZ directly (no 'did you mean' needed).
evidence.false_stub_note: decomp.db flags this is_stub=1 FALSELY: the function IS implemented in src/system/synth/filterdesign.cpp:467-471 (compute_bpres() + zplane.zeros[0]=reflect(zplane.poles[0]); zplane.zeros[1]=reflect(zplane.poles[1])) and builds to 40.6% normalized. The orchestrator MUST clear the stale is_stub flag (UPDATE functions SET is_stub=0 WHERE symbol='?compute_apres@@YAXXZ') BEFORE running certify_floor --manual-file ... --apply, because certify_floor.manual_certify() adds 'AND is_stub=0' to its resolver for every cert class except native_divergence, so an is_stub=1 row resolves to 0 matches and the entry is REFUSED ('ERROR ... 0 matches'). This was the wave-15 blocker.
